build_conv_downsample_1d: build a ConvDownsample1d module to downsample 1D tensors by an integer stride using convolution
build_conv_tr_upsample_1d: build a ConvTrUpsample1d module to upsample 1D tensors by an integer stride using transposed convolution
test_conv_downsample_1d_learnt: test the ConvDownsample1d class with learnt=True to use trainable convolution weights for downsampling
test_conv_tr_upsample_1d_causal: test the ConvTrUpsample1d class with causal=True to use causal transposed convolution for upsampling
review_conv_downsample_channel_wise: review the ConvDownsample1d class channel_wise parameter to apply per-channel downsampling with grouped convolutions
